fullPassage: The science we learn in grade school is a collection of certainties about the natural world — the earth goes around the sun, DNA carries the information of an organism, and so on. Only when you start to learn the practice of science do you realize that each of these "facts" was hard won through a succession of logical inferences based upon many observations or experiments. The process of science is less about collecting pieces of knowledge than it is about reducing the uncertainties in what we know. Our uncertainties can be greater or lesser for any given piece of knowledge depending upon where we are in that process — today we are quite certain of how an apple will fall from a tree, but our understanding of the turbulent fluid flow remains a work in progress after more than a century of effort.

det.analysis: 'each of these facts was hard __________'에서 be동사(was) 뒤에 수동태를 이루는 과거분사가 필요. 사실이 '힘들게 얻어졌다'는 수동 의미. win의 과거분사는 won(win-won-won). hard won = 힘들게 얻어진
det.tip: win - won - won. was (hard) won = 힘들게 얻어졌다 (수동태)

questions.passage: The science we learn in grade school is a collection of __________ about the natural world — the earth goes around the sun, DNA carries the information of an organism, and so on. Only when you start to learn the practice of science do you realize that each of these "facts" was hard won through a succession of logical inferences based upon many observations or experiments. The process of science is less about collecting pieces of knowledge than it is about reducing the uncertainties in what we know. Our uncertainties can be greater or lesser for any given piece of knowledge depending upon where we are in that process — today we are quite certain of how an apple will fall from a tree, but our understanding of the turbulent fluid flow remains a work in progress after more than a century of effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① certainties: 'The science we learn in grade school is a collection of __________ about the natural world'에서 뒤에 이어지는 '지구가 태양을 돈다, DNA가 정보를 담는다' 등 확실한 사실 예시로 보아 '확실한 것들(certainties)'이 적절 ←정답

❌ ② mysteries(미스터리): 확실한 사실 예시와 상충

❌ ③ opinions(의견): 과학적 사실 맥락과 부적절

❌ ④ questions(질문): 확실한 사실 나열과 상충
det.tip: a collection of certainties = 확실한 것들의 모음 (초등 과학의 성격)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: work in progress=진행 중인 작업/미완성 상태
det.analysis:
❌ ① solved problem(해결된 문제): 한 세기 넘게 노력했지만 아직 이해가 끝나지 않았다는 맥락과 반대

❌ ② proven fact(입증된 사실): 여전히 불확실하다는 맥락과 상충

❌ ③ closed case(종결된 사안): 아직 진행 중이라는 맥락과 반대

✅ ④ work in progress: 'our understanding of the turbulent fluid flow remains a __________ after more than a century of effort'에서 난류 이해가 한 세기 넘는 노력 후에도 여전히 '진행 중(work in progress)'이라는 맥락 ←정답
det.tip: remains a work in progress = 여전히 진행 중인 상태로 남아 있다
